title: Countable coordinate enlargement invariant under an endomorphism
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $J$ a set and $(N_j)_{j\in J}$ a family of $R$-modules, each countably generated, meaning generated by an at most countable subset. Put $M=\bigoplus_{j\in J}N_j$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-sum-modules]. For $A\subseteq J$, write $M_A$ for the coordinate submodule of families supported in $A$ (the support is the set of indices with nonzero coordinate). Let $f:M\to M$ be any $R$-linear endomorphism. For every at most countable subset $C\subseteq J$ there exists an at most countable subset $D\subseteq J$ containing $C$ such that $f(M_D)\subseteq M_D$. No countability hypothesis on $R$ or on the underlying sets of the $N_j$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 058X, theorem-kaplansky-direct-sum, proof lines 20511–20552: the countable support-closure construction, stated here for one linear endomorphism; the source applies it to complementary projections.

proof.text: For each $j\in J$, apply [lem-trf-countably-generated-image-support] to $L=N_j$ and $h=f\circ\iota_j$, where $\iota_j$ is the canonical inclusion of [def-weil-pbc-direct-sum-modules]. The hypothesis holds because $N_j$ is countably generated. By classical choice over the set $J$, choose these countable support bounds simultaneously, obtaining a family $(F_j)_{j\in J}$ of subsets of $J$; for every $x\in N_j$, $\operatorname{supp}(f(\iota_j(x)))\subseteq F_j$. These are bounds on generator-image supports, not on coefficients or on underlying module cardinalities.

source.place: Tag 058X, theorem-kaplansky-direct-sum, proof lines 20511-20552, countable generator-support enlargement; assembly of the two extracted lemmas.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-countable-successor-coordinate-exhaustion] to these $F_j$ and the given countable $C$. It gives the increasing countable stages $A_0=C$, $A_{k+1}=A_k\cup\bigcup_{j\in A_k}F_j$, and a countable $D=\bigcup_kA_k$ containing $C$. For the present family of modules, it also gives $M_D=\bigcup_kM_{A_k}$.

source.place: Tag 058X, theorem-kaplansky-direct-sum, proof lines 20511-20552, countable generator-support enlargement; assembly of the two extracted lemmas.

proof.text: For $y\in M_D$, choose $k$ with $y\in M_{A_k}$ using [lem-trf-countable-successor-coordinate-exhaustion]. By [def-weil-pbc-direct-sum-modules], $y=\sum_{j\in\operatorname{supp}(y)}\iota_j(y_j)$ is a finite sum, and every such $j$ lies in $A_k$ [def-trf-coordinate-submodule]. The defining recursion gives $F_j\subseteq A_{k+1}$ for $j\in A_k$. Step 1, using [lem-trf-countably-generated-image-support], gives $\operatorname{supp}(f(\iota_j(y_j)))\subseteq F_j$. For each $t\notin A_{k+1}$ every term has zero $t$-coordinate. Linearity and componentwise addition therefore give $(f(y))_t=\sum_{j\in\operatorname{supp}(y)}(f(\iota_j(y_j)))_t=0$. This includes the empty sum. Thus $f(y)\in M_{A_{k+1}}$. Since $A_{k+1}\subseteq D$, any coordinate outside $D$ is outside $A_{k+1}$ and therefore zero in $f(y)$; hence $f(y)\in M_D$, proving invariance.
